name: Instatic Visual Website Builder and CMS
description: Open-source Webflow alternative: visual editor, CMS and clean HTML output.

upstream.version: 0.0.21 (tag v0.0.21, commit d1abbefacb2e716dcab4c29ca972e2eb32dfab42; image ghcr.io/corebunch/instatic:0.0.21, index digest sha256:6aa56b7d048f894c7821d1e7debd94a54e09bcc45332ad04d51e30e20545bca0, created 2026-10-12)

INSTATIC_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Required. Your email: the Owner account is created with it on first boot, before the site goes online. It is your sign-in name; Instatic never sends email.

INSTATIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Owner password, generated at deploy. Read on the first boot only; change it under Account after signing in.

INSTATIC_SITE_NAME.description: Site name set on the first boot. Rename the site later in Site settings.

PORT.description: Port the Instatic server listens on. The public domain and the healthcheck use it.

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres on the private network. sqlite:/app/storage/data/cms.db switches to SQLite (then delete the Postgres service).

UPLOADS_DIR.description: Media, fonts, plugin packages and published pages. Must stay on the /app/storage volume.

RUNTIME_CACHE_DIR.description: npm packages installed at publish time for published pages. On the volume so they survive redeploys.

STATIC_DIR.description: Built admin app inside the image. Do not change.

PUBLIC_ORIGIN.description: Public origin(s) trusted by the CSRF check, comma-separated. Append https://{your-domain} when you add a custom domain.

INSTATIC_SECRET_KEY.description: Base64 32-byte key that encrypts AI provider keys, plugin secrets and MFA seeds. Generated once; keep it, never rotate it casually.

TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS.description: Optional. Proxy CIDRs whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted for audit-log IPs and rate-limit keys. Never 0.0.0.0/0.

INSTATIC_DB_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long the boot waits for Postgres before giving up (Railway then restarts the service).

INSTATIC_VERSION.description: Instatic image tag, used as a build argument. Change it and redeploy to upgrade; read the changelog first.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time between SIGTERM and SIGKILL so live co-editing documents are flushed on redeploy.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized.

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when image is started.

DATABASE_URL.description: URL to connect to Postgres database.

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to Postgres DB.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to cleanly shut down.
